author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇷🇴  Georgescu has been taken in by DIICOT over an alleged €1.1M fraud scheme and he is in hearings now...

No conviction and the allegations still have to be proven in court. No evidence has been presented since 2024...

Fmr. presidential candidate George Simion is standing with him:

“Any of us could be next. Stop the abuses!”

Georgescu won the first round of the 2024 presidential election before its annulment by the Constitutional Court of Romania.

Writer: Samuel
